# UntoCaesar

> Open-source tax filing on local AI, for individuals, businesses and volunteer sites. Status: planned, not released; check SUPPORTED.md before doing any step.

Cloud providers are personal use only and live only in Fonsviva. Apps never hold provider keys. UntoCaesar client work and Corunis are blocked from cloud.

## Setup
- [For agents: quickstart](https://baney75.github.io/UntoCaesar/agents): rules and order of steps
- [Install](https://baney75.github.io/UntoCaesar/setup/install): steps, checks, expected output
- [Connect to Fonsviva](https://baney75.github.io/UntoCaesar/setup/connect-fonsviva)
- [Select models](https://baney75.github.io/UntoCaesar/setup/select-models)
- [Add a cloud provider](https://baney75.github.io/UntoCaesar/setup/add-cloud-provider)
- [Troubleshoot](https://baney75.github.io/UntoCaesar/setup/troubleshoot)
